summary: P4 has been driven through verified real SubPipe corpus readiness, L4 readiness, P4.8 rehearsal, budget pilot, optimized 100-step benchmark, and fail-closed promotion review. The formal 100000-step P4.8 run remains blocked by the user-defined 1000 TL cloud cap and cannot be substituted by the benchmark.

blockers.detail: The optimized full 100000-step P4.8 projection is 1090.64 TL cumulative, exceeding the user-defined 1000 TL cap by 90.64 TL.
The 100-step benchmark is non-promotable and failed the effective-rank threshold; it cannot clear P4.8 or unlock P4.9.

options: Raise the cloud budget cap above the projected 1090.64 TL cumulative estimate and explicitly authorize the formal run.
Provide cheaper qualifying CUDA compute with at least 16 GB VRAM and persistence long enough for the 100000-step run.
Explicitly revise the formal P4.8 requirement through a controlled architecture amendment.
required_user_controlled_action.without_action: Do not launch full P4.8, do not promote U1 sonar, and do not advance to P4.9.

cloud_state_at_closeout.expected: All Conrad Google Cloud VMs stopped/terminated.
cloud_state_at_closeout.spend_policy: No new cloud run may start unless it is within the cap or the user explicitly raises the cap.
